messages:
maria: FYI running into a weird stack when using AsyncClient against Dedicated with a custom CA and REDWOOD_BASE_URL set in env. sample app also confused me because it shipped sync code.
ashwin: can you paste a minimal repro? is this with the aio client or the sync client?
maria: Async. repro below:
```python
import os
from redwood import AsyncClient

os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL'] = 'https://dedicated-east.redwood.internal'
client = AsyncClient(api_key='x', trust_bundle='/etc/pki/custom-ca.pem')
await client.chat.create(model='gpt-small', input='hi')
```
error: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate

kyle: hmm — does the client actually prefer an explicit base_url param over REDWOOD_BASE_URL? I remember some precedence bugs.
maria: I also tried passing base_url directly and it still hit the cert error. but when I set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE it works (sync), so it seems async path isn't loading the trust_bundle file.
sam: which transport is AsyncClient using under the hood? aiohttp or httpx?
maria: httpx async. digging into transport shows they build an ssl.SSLContext but they call load_verify_locations with bytes sometimes. stack trace shows: "TypeError: a bytes-like object is required, not 'str'" in one branch, but in the other branch they never call load_verify_locations at all.
ashwin: ouch. two separate bugs then: (1) env var/base_url precedence inconsistent, (2) async/httpx SSLContext creation path mishandles trust_bundle types.
julie: also saw a docs mismatch — quickstart in console uses `requests` sync code for the Dedicated sample. people copy/paste and then try to plug into async frameworks and hit different behavior. we should make the sample app explicit about which client it uses.
maria: yeah onboarding friction — I raised a support ticket and they suggested adding `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` as a workaround. not great for async.
sam: minimal fix proposal: ensure AsyncClient constructs SSLContext with `ssl.create_default_context(cafile=...)` (accepts str path), and make environment variables precedence: explicit param > REDWOOD_BASE_URL env > default. add tests for both sync and async paths.
kyle: also add typing for AsyncClient.__init__ to accept trust_bundle: Optional[str] in stubs so mypy catches when users pass bytes.
ashwin: I'll open an issue and link a PR template. julie can you update the sample app docs to show both sync and async snippets and call out env var recommendations?
julie: on it. I can also add a tiny dockerized sample app that mounts a cert file so Dedicated customers can run locally.
dev-bot: created issue #5421: "python-async: trust_bundle handling + base_url precedence + docs sample mismatch" — https://redwood-internal/issue/5421 :eyes:
maria: thanks. one more request — can we add a helper `ClientConfig` dataclass so onboarding code can construct config from env and be shared between sync/async examples? reduces copy/paste errors.
kyle: love that. low friction and helps types.
ashwin: assigning to @eng-ml for the async SSL fix, @devex for docs, and @sdk for typing. adding labels: bug, docs, sdk-typing, priority-medium.
maria: awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
